applications.relevant_experience: I have over 5 years of experience in childcare and household management. I worked as a nanny for two families, caring for children ages 2-8, managing daily routines, preparing healthy meals, and maintaining a clean, organized home environment. I also have experience in customer service roles where I developed strong communication and problem-solving skills.
applications.why_interested: I'm excited about the opportunity to be a founding member of Parentive and help shape a new model of household support. I'm drawn to the meaningful, hands-on nature of the work and the chance to make a real difference in families' lives. I appreciate that this isn't traditional gig work but rather a role where I can build relationships and contribute to something innovative from the ground up.
applications.strengths: My key strengths include reliability, attention to detail, and excellent interpersonal skills. I'm highly organized and can efficiently manage multiple tasks while maintaining quality. I have a warm, approachable personality that helps me build trust with both children and adults. I'm also adaptable and quick to learn, which I believe will be valuable as Parentive develops its standards and processes.
applications.child_support_experience: I have extensive experience working with children ages 2-8 as a nanny. I'm comfortable with age-appropriate activities, homework help, and creating engaging educational experiences. I understand child development stages and can adapt my approach to each child's needs and personality.
applications.child_engagement_approach: I believe in active, meaningful engagement with children. I focus on being present and attentive, following their lead while gently guiding them toward positive behaviors. I use creative play, storytelling, and hands-on activities to keep children engaged. I also believe in clear communication, setting appropriate boundaries, and creating a safe, nurturing environment where children feel valued and heard.
applications.first_aid_certification_details: Standard First Aid & CPR-C, expires March 2027
applications.how_did_you_hear_about_us: I found Parentive through a job posting on LinkedIn
